title: CPSC, Creative Kids Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Art Supply Sets
summary: The sets contain mini-cutters with razor blades, which pose a laceration hazard to young children. Units: 1,400.

title: CPSC, Trisonic Announce Recall of Nightlights
summary: The nightlight poses a serious electrocution, electric shock, burn and fire hazard to consumers. Units: 12,000.

title: CPSC, Trivett Industries, Inc. Announce Recall of Pancake Makers
summary: The handles on the pancake makers are unable to withstand the heat of the device, causing the handle to fail to provide support, because of melting or breaking. Units: 590.

title: CPSC, Weather Works Announce Recall of Electric Heaters
summary: The electric heater can overheat internal plastic components and damage the wiring, posing a fire and electrocution hazard to consumers. Units: 2,400.

title: CPSC, Babi Italia/LaJobi Industries Announce Recall to Replace "Tiffany" and "Josephine" Crib Drop-Side Rails
summary: The slats on the drop-side rails can come loose or detach. A child's head can get caught in the space left by loose or missing slats, presenting an entrapment hazard. In addition, children can fall through the slat opening. Units: About 2,000.

title: CPSC, NHTSA, and Dorel Juvenile Group Inc. Announce Extended Recall of Infant Car Seats/Carriers
summary: When the seat is used as a carrier, the plastic handle locks can unexpectedly break or release from the carrying position, causing the seat to unlatch or flip forward. When this happens, an infant can fall to the ground and suffer injuries. Units: 1.2 million.

title: CPSC, Bombardier Motor Corporation of America Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
summary: The Start/RER switch for the SDI models and the Start switch for the V-1000 models may be defective, creating two potential problems: Condition A: If the operator leaves the engine cut out switch in the "ON" position and the tether cut out switch cap on the switch post, the vehicle may start by itse

title: CPSC, Ontel Products Announce Recall of Food Slicer
summary: The exposed slicing blade on top of the unit can cut a consumer's fingers or hand during use. Units: 32,900.

title: CPSC, QVC Inc. Announce Recall of Food Choppers
summary: Consumers can cut their fingers and hands while using the product. Units: About 7,300.

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Crib Mobile Toys
summary: If batteries used in the mobile leak, the caustic liquid can seep out of the battery compartment, posing a risk of chemical burns to babies. Units: 233,000.

title: CPSC, Homier Distributing Co. Announce Recall of Extension Cords, Portable Lights, and Fluorescent Work Lights
summary: The extension cords and lights have undersized wiring, are not properly polarized, have inadequate grounding, faulty electrical connections, and plastic handles that, once ignited, continue to burn and spread flames, posing a shock, electrocution, and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 150,000 E

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motor Corp. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: The throttle cable adjuster on the carburetor can loosen during operation, causing it to stick, which can cause the rider to lose control and possibly crash. Units: 3,000.
